title: Show HN: Searchable directory of 22k+ products from worker-owned co-ops
summary: A searchable directory featuring over 22,000 products from worker-owned cooperatives, helping consumers discover and support businesses that are owned and controlled by their workers rather than traditional shareholders.
problem_solved: Connects consumers with worker-owned businesses by providing a searchable database of 22k+ products from cooperatives worldwide.
why_valuable: Promotes economic democracy and helps conscious consumers make purchasing decisions that support worker-owned enterprises.
